decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting remains distant from the core and its results are still unclear, but long naval procurement cycles and the expanding firm's slack let management carry it rather than trigger problemistic search.
The medical examination light builds on established competencies and serves institutional customers, and with no observed shortfall against aspirations there is no reason to withdraw it.
The explosion-proof industrial line extends the core certified industrial business in a growing market and likely meets aspirations, so dropping it is unwarranted.

The pendant office luminaire sits close to the core offer, but office lighting is crowded and pandemic-era office demand was weak, so there is some risk of falling short of aspirations, though slack favours keeping it for now.
The premium pendant line with several models represents a larger commitment close to the core, and without evidence of a shortfall management keeps it while monitoring results.
